api_fields_documentation.release_type: Package format: 'Full OTA (ZIP)', 'Incremental OTA', or 'IMG / PKG Recovery'.
api_fields_documentation.is_test_release: Boolean flag indicating if the package was a Beta/Test release candidate.
api_fields_documentation.package_size: Formatted binary package file size in GB/MB.
api_fields_documentation.release_date: Official publication date or build compilation date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM).
api_fields_documentation.sha256: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash checksum for enhanced security and verification.
api_fields_documentation.crc32: IEEE 802.3 32-bit Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC32) hexadecimal checksum.
api_fields_documentation.changelog: Official release notes and changelog description.
api_fields_documentation.download_url: Direct primary CDN download URL on official TCL CDN.
api_fields_documentation.all_cdn_urls: Dictionary mapping regional CDN keys to direct mirror download URLs.
api_fields_documentation.extracted_details: Deep build properties extracted from the package payload.
